BiblicalUsage: Hilen is a town in Judah given to the sons of Aaron as a city of refuge. It stands in the list of the cities where a man who slew his neighbour unawares could flee and live, one of the safe places set aside in the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cities of refuge show God's heart for the one who never meant to kill, and Hilen is one of those mercies.
